title: Leia as a Pin-Up
description: LEIA AS A PIN-UP was probably the last thing audiences expected in the chaste STAR WARS universe. But in RETURN OF THE JEDI, the princess' plan to steal into Jabba's palace in disguise and rescue Han Solo is thwarted; as revenge, Jabba dresses her as a dancing girl to replace Oola, whom he has dispatched to Rancor-dom. Here (front) is a near-final version of the costume designed by Aggie Guerard Rodgers and Nilo Rodis-Jamero in a sketch by Rodis-Jamero.
